name: Continue
tagline: Open-source AI code assistant for VS Code and JetBrains powered by local models
real_test_summary: Delivered sub-400ms tab autocomplete in VS Code on macOS M2 16GB RAM paired with Qwen2.5-Coder 7B via Ollama.
pros: Keeps proprietary source code 100% on local machine
Supports both Tab autocomplete and multi-file edits
Works in VS Code and all JetBrains IDEs
cons: Requires running separate Ollama or llama.cpp backend
Autocomplete latency depends on local RAM/VRAM bandwidth
description: IDE extension enabling inline autocomplete, codebase-aware chat, and multi-file refactoring using local Ollama models like Qwen2.5-Coder without sending source code to third-party servers.
